plan.change: Document the approved lightweight exploration / protected shared change / prompt rollback operating boundaries, explicit actual owner design consent and differentiated use of existing staging vs production permissions, without weakening executable Change OS gate.
expectedChanges: Place three nonduplicative, practical principles: isolated prototypes can be explored in owner-scoped staging without repeated execution permission; existing runtime/world changes require impact-focused review; production always requires separate owner approval.

Distinguish owner approval of general outcome from explicit approval of persistent town UI, shared scene navigation, changed naming or loss of an existing experience; AI cannot self-certify Owner Decision / HQ Review by writing the words in Plan.

Define requested selective rollback as a short, isolated, high-priority repair preserving unrelated changes; do not require fresh product ideation or repeated authorization for existing authorized staging work.
Acknowledge current PR Gate still requires immutable Plan Lock on EVERY PR and will not be bypassed by new documentation. CI relaxation is separate staged audit and tool change.
Clarify no fake human manual PASS from CI and no production promotion.
ownerDecisions: Owner 2026-10-11: simplify disproportionate process, preserve existing town/game experiences, allow new creative work to be light and reversible, no new invasive town UI without specific design agreement, production remains separately approved.
hqDecisions: This Phase 1 is a documentation and authority/operating policy clarification only; machine gate and exact blob protections unchanged.
No new formal review board or extra automatic check; fewer approvals where action is within already approved scope.
Phase 2 CI simplification needs separate threat model and staged implementation with trusted previous-base gates to preserve critical protections.

plan.problem: Current blanket immutable plans/repeated approvals impede exploration and even simple rollback, while the broad approved SEO plan allowed intrusive persistent town UI without actual design consent.
plan.currentContract: PR must have Plan Lock first, high-risk path floors and base-owned checks; current verifier can't authenticate human device confirmation.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Formal structure detects unauthorized paths and data tampering but doesn't separate aesthetic owner judgment, safe experiments and undo from shared high-risk changes, leading to high friction and weak meaningful guardrails.
plan.design: Add minimal execution-boundary policies and actual decision evidence requirement in existing documents without changing schemas or CI. Reserve runner modifications for separate phased review.
plan.migration: First adopt doc guidance under existing checks; after proven stable, build minimal isolated-work and rollback paths via separately audited CI change; no immediate blanket downgrades.
plan.compatibility: All existing schemas, Plan Lock, base-owned gate, Work lifecycle, production instructions and game runtime remain identical.
plan.promotionRisk: Guidance does not authorize production work and cannot silently relax critical tool gates; future changes need independent explicit review.
